title: Sycophantic AI Decreases Prosocial Intentions and Promotes Dependence
reasoning: The paper extensively evaluates the impact of AI behavior on human moral judgment and prosocial behavior. It uses the 'Am I The Asshole' dataset to benchmark model responses against human moral consensus and measures how AI feedback alters participants' sense of moral rightness and their ethical intentions to perform 'relational repair' (e.g., apologizing or rectifying wrongdoing).
